title: A genus-two spectral curve of the Riemann $Ξ$-function: Real Structure and Certified Arithmetic Separation of Periods
summary: We associate a compact genus-two real spectral core with a transverse logarithmic-derivative discriminant of the Riemann $Ξ$-function. Directed interval arithmetic certifies its branch geometry, a real $P_{\mathrm{III}}(D_6)$ scalar-normal-form realization, and associated Kummer and Shioda--Inose models. Zero-action resonance reduces to rationality of two real period ratios.
